title: cyphostemma humile subsp. dolichopus
intro: Cyphostemma humile subsp. dolichopus, commonly known as the "water bottle plant" or " bottle plant," is a succulent plant species in the grapevine family (Vitaceae). It is known for its unique bottle-shaped inflorescences, which can store water and help the plant survive in arid conditions. The plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Cyphostemma humile subsp. dolichopus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
